دَأْدَأَةٌ inf. n. of R. Q. 1 [q. v.]. (S, M, K.) ―
-b2- Also The hasty replying of a foolish, or stupid, person. (T, TA.) ―
-b3- The sound of the falling (T, M, K) of stones in a torrent, (T,) or of a stone upon the bed of a torrent: (M, K:) or the falling of stones in the bed of a torrent. (Lth, IKtt, O.) ―
-b4- And The sound of one's moving, or putting in motion, [or rocking,] a child in the cradle (K, TA) in order that it may sleep. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also the next paragraph, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
